[[File:TanoGargoyle-Overlords.png|thumb|right|250px|The Son in gargoyle form]]
A '''gargoyle''' was a mythical creature that was shaped like a [[Bat/Legends|bat]] with huge wings. On [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], it symbolized the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. The [[Son/Legends|Son]] could transform himself into a gargoyle at will.

Many planets included statuary gargoyles in their architecture, including [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] and [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
